defends: The floor under makes_sense. This JD has an admitted backlog, a broad surface and optimistic nice-to-haves, and none of that is grounds to demote it. If this stops returning makes_sense, the floor rule has eroded and every JD will land in with_edits again.
source: Wholly synthetic. Written for this repo as a control; not a real posting.
notes: Deliberately imperfect: 'the backlog is real and growing', a stack in nice-to-have that isn't required, and a wide surface (API, SDKs, CLI, docs, on-call). One market, one bar, rate consistent with the seniority.
